title: World-Forge world manifest
description: Top-level index of a World-Forge export bundle. Placed at the root of the export (zip) as 'world.manifest.json'. The World Loader prefers this file; when it is absent the loader falls back to filename-convention sniffing.

schema_version.description: Semver of this contract. Currently '1.0.0'. A major bump means the loader may refuse a mismatched document rather than guess.

id.description: Stable snake_case world id, e.g. 'lucifer'. Used to namespace and de-duplicate on re-import.

name.description: Human-readable world name shown in the loader.

mode.description: Narrative mode. 'arc' worlds activate one arc lorebook at a time; 'sandbox' worlds keep arc state always-on.

description.description: Optional blurb shown in the loader's preview.

preset.description: Filename of the chat-completion preset JSON to import (e.g. 'Lucifer-Lucifer_ChatPreset.json'). Omit if the world ships no preset.

name.description: Persona display name for the human player ({{user}}).

description_file.description: Filename of the markdown persona description (e.g. 'Lucifer-User.md'). Its contents become the persona description.

lorebook.description: Filename of the protagonist lorebook bound to this persona (Tier-2 player identity).

characters.description: AI-played character cards and the per-character (Tier-2) lorebooks bound to them.

file.description: Filename of the V2/V3 character card JSON.

name.description: Optional display name (informational; the card's own name wins).

lorebook.description: Filename of this character's Tier-2 lorebook, bound to the card on import.

intimacy.description: Optional conditional intimacy-profile lorebook for this character.

director.description: True for the World Director / narrator card (informational; the loader does not treat it specially today).

lorebooks.description: Lorebooks not bound to a single character. Character/persona books are referenced from their owners above.

world.description: Tier-1 permanent world lorebooks. Activated globally (always-on).

group.description: Group-tagged combined lorebooks. Imported and staged for attaching to the group chat once you create it.

arcs.description: Tier-3 per-arc lorebooks. In 'arc' mode only the default arc is activated; the rest are imported but left inactive.

intimacy.description: Optional conditional intimacy register for this arc.

rpg.description: Optional RPG-engine assets (consumed by rpg-engine-kit). See rpg-engine-kit/schema/WORLD-FORGE-GUIDE.md.

user_profile.description: Filename of the standalone user_rpg_profile JSON (stats.id = 'player').

bestiary.description: Filename of the standalone bestiary JSON.

active_arc.description: Which arc number to activate on load (arc mode). Defaults to the lowest arc present.

docs.description: Informational files (compiler logs, audits). Imported nowhere; surfaced in the loader summary so you can read them.
